title: Valid Anagram
statement_short: Given two strings s and t, return true if t is an anagram of s, and false otherwise. An anagram is formed by rearranging the letters of a different word using all original letters exactly once.
constraints: 1 <= s.length, t.length <= 5 \* 10^4, s and t consist of lowercase English letters
hint: Input size up to 5 \* 10^4 demands an O(n) time solution using character frequency counting.
keywords: using all original letters exactly once
why_not: Right: HashMap / Hash Set tallies character frequencies in O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space (26 lowercase letters). Not Sorting: Sorting both strings takes O(n log n) time, which is slower than linear frequency counting. Not Two Pointers: Linear scanning without frequency storage cannot verify unordered letter permutations. Not Bit Manipulation: Bitmasks track character presence but cannot record duplicate character frequencies.
